text: Two parents. Same RM eight thousand saved. One saves up to RM two thousand in tax.
asr: Two parents. Same RM8000 saved. One saves up to RM2000 in tax.

text: The difference is hiding in two columns.
Trap one: withdraw in the same year, even your dividends, and your relief shrinks.
Trap two: an S S P N in your own name gets zero relief.
asr: Trap two: an SSPN in your own name gets zero relief.

text: Do it right, and RM eight thousand of relief saves RM eight hundred and eighty, RM one thousand five hundred and twenty, or RM two thousand, depending on your tax band.
asr: Do it right, and RM8000 of relief saves RM880, RM1520, or RM2000, depending on your tax band.

text: The money must reach P T P T N by thirty-first December. Not paying at a counter? Pay by the twenty-fifth.
asr: The money must reach PTPTN by 31st December. Not paying at a counter? Pay by the 25th.
